thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: APIGW 502 spike in eu-west-1. Error rate up 18% over 5m. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Alerting on throughput loss and customer-facing failures.
Ada: I'm on call. jumping in — checking dashboards now.
Ben: pinging infra to confirm any recent deploys. ops-bot: Recent deployment: api-gateway v2.4.1 rolled at 12:02 UTC to eu-west-1 (change: keepalive timeout lowered).
Ada: rolling back gateway config to previous keepalive at 12:10 UTC, can someone verify traffic? 
Cy: looking at edge logs — seeing a lot of `upstream_response_timeout` + `502` from internal mux. Sample:
```
2026-03-17T12:04:15.123Z ERROR proxy: upstream_response_timeout route=/v1/generate upstream=internal-mux-3
```
Diana: curious — connection pool exhaustion? we have a surge in concurrent long-polling chat requests.
Ben: will open a short-lived circuit-breaker for /v1/chat and reduce max_connections on backend to prevent head-of-line blocking. applying now.
Ada: also enabling retry_budget for client retries to smooth transient 502s. applying policy change in traffic-router.
Sam: traffic shift to us-east-1 by 20% to relieve eu-west. initiating gradual shift: `./traffic-shift --from eu-west-1 --to us-east-1 --pct 20 --duration 5m`
Rachel: customers impacted: a handful of high-throughput accounts saw 10-30% increased errors, support loop opened (INC-6312). No broad outage yet.
Ada: status update in 10m. If errors don't drop below 3% we'll rollback the gateway service.
Cy: metrics show 502 rate dropping to 9% after circuit breaker and shift.
ops-bot: Playbook step completed: applied circuit-breaker to /v1/chat (runbook id: rb-gw-502-03).
Ben: reconfigured connection pool to 200 -> 400 for internal-mux. hoping to clear backlog.
Diana: seeing some leftover saturation on mux-2; I'll spin up an extra replica.
Ada: creating a canary re-deploy of api-gateway with default keepalive for eu-west behind flag. `kubectl set image deployment/api-gateway api-gateway=redwood/api-gateway:v2.4.0-canary`
Sam: logs look healthier. 502s at 2.8% now, latency stable.
Rachel: support notified customers most impacted, triage notes sent.
Ada: lowering pager severity to monitoring. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Pager resolved: error rate returned below threshold for 10m. Incident closed for now. See runbook rb-gw-502-03 and INC-6312 for postmortem.
Ben: postmortem owner? Ada: I'll take it. Will add timeline and config diffs.
Diana: follow-up action — add circuit-breaker defaults to new gateway builds and increase pool autoscaling margin.
Sam: adding dashboard panels for per-route connection pool metrics.
Ada: thanks team — great mitigation. we'll sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC for RCA.
